name: hf_hub
summary: Single connector exposing the full Hugging Face surface to the chain. Three capabilities in one module: (1) Hub search / model_card / list_datasets — browse the ~1M+ models and ~200k datasets without downloading anything. (2) Unified inference() that routes through HF's OpenAI-compatible router across 19 cloud providers, falling back across the priority list on error. (3) stream_dataset() — pull rows from a HF dataset via the datasets-server API, no full parquet download. Every inference call crystals into the chain so MoE retrieval can find prior similar HF calls without re-spending tokens.
engine_pattern: stdlib-only urllib HTTPS client. No huggingface_hub Python dep required. Token resolved from HF_TOKEN env → HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN env → ~/.cache/huggingface/token → .env in priority order. Every inference call gets a deterministic crystal computed over (provider, model, prompt, output, max_tokens, temperature) and appended to studio/hf_hub/log.jsonl. Fallback router walks INFERENCE_PROVIDERS in order on error.

providers.rationale: groq + cerebras lead the ordering — fastest tokens/sec for most models. hf-inference last as canonical fallback. Card-level overrides via try_providers param.
providers.note: Same prompt → same OpenAI-shaped payload → 19 different gateways. The chain doesn't have to know which one served the call; the InferenceResult.provider field records it for replay.

capabilities.inference: POST /v1/chat/completions through router — provider via X-HF-Provider or model-path prefix
capabilities.stream_dataset: GET datasets-server.huggingface.co/rows — paginated rows without parquet download

substrate: studio/hf_hub/log.jsonl (per-call entries: ts, provider, model, tokens, latency, crystal, preview)

inbound_callers: core/cc.sh::cmd_hf_search | cmd_hf_card | cmd_hf_datasets | cmd_hf_infer | cmd_hf_stream | cmd_hf_providers
model_installer (extends search to live cloud, not just local installs)

the_unified_surface: One Python module spans Hugging Face's entire model/dataset hub + 19 inference providers. Workflow cards declare 'engine: hf' + a provider preference; studio_runtime routes through hf_hub.inference() which fans across providers and returns the first success. The chain gains access to thousands of frontier models on tap without paying for ANTHROPIC_API_KEY-level access.
guarantees: Crystal-anchored — every inference call has a deterministic BLAKE3 of (provider, model, prompt, output)
Fallback-resilient — when any provider errors, walks the rest of the 19 in priority order
Free-tier-aware — most providers offer generous free quotas; the router picks cheapest-fastest available
stdlib-only — zero new Python deps; ships in the existing substrate
Cache-compatible — crystals plug into result_cache + MoE retrieval so prior identical calls return without re-spending tokens
usage_example:
# Search
cc hf-search 'kimi instruct' --limit 5

# Inference (fans across providers on fallback)
cc hf-infer moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Instruct 'Explain Mixamo rigging in 1 sentence' --provider groq --max-tokens 200

# Dataset rows without download
cc hf-stream HuggingFaceH4/no_robots --split train --limit 5
